children: announced the appointment of Dennis Kwong as chief financial officer of the company, effective September 15th, 2026.

Most recently, Kwong served as Chief Financial Officer of Florida Canyon Gold, where he assisted in the spinout and public listing of the company as part of the business combination between Argonaut Gold and Alamos Gold

Before Florida Canyon Gold, Kwong spent approximately 15 years with Centerra Gold, where he held positions including executive vice president, business development; vice president, business development and exploration; and Vice President, Business Development.
Earlier in his career, Kwong held senior business development positions with Xstrata Nickel, Falconbridge, and Noranda.
